title: Pollen balances and subscription tiers stay in sync
summary:
A little New Year housekeeping: Pollen and tier fixes, VisionAI in the app showcase, and expired Seedream promo labels cleared away.

Balance lookup now checks Polar when the stored balance is zero, helping purchased Pollen appear without overwriting a spent balance. Subscription grant events also update both the stored tier and daily Pollen balance after tier changes.

@Superheroghost’s Pollinations VisionAI was added to the app catalog and README showcase. The public image-generation UI supports Pollinations models and API keys.

The expired 99% off badge and promotional descriptions were removed from `seedream` and `seedream-pro`, following the promotion’s scheduled December 31 end.
